speaker: narrator
text: The pod did not go to Mum. It zoomed all the way across the galaxy and landed somewhere cold and grand. This was Dad's palace. And Luna's dad was the strict King who ruled the whole galaxy. Two enormous guards stomped over and marched Luna inside.

speaker: narrator
text: said Dad, tapping his diamond sceptre.

speaker: dad
text: "Who is THIS? My own daughter, at last."

speaker: luna
text: "It was an accident. I just want to go home."

speaker: dad
text: "You will stay here. One day you will be Queen of the whole universe — so you must learn to be a proper princess. Pretty dresses. Fancy balls. Perfect manners."

speaker: luna
text: "But I don't WANT to wear dresses,"

speaker: dad
text: "You will go to my royal school,"

speaker: dad
text: "And that animal cannot stay. We do not keep pets here. Guards — take the bunny away."

speaker: narrator
text: cried Luna. But the guards carried her wriggling bunny off down the hall.
